desc: 黄铜重铸恒温阀体多键分档出水，黑金撞色大顶喷与多档手持花洒
leaf: 哑光黑金分体式恒温黄铜淋浴花洒套装
name: 黑金恒温分体式黄铜花洒款

shots.intent: 搜索首图一眼看清整套配置与哑光黑金撞色，赢点击。
用材质撞色与实景墙面前置颜值主张，一秒传达差异化卖点。
shots.textZone: right 40% vertical margin: headline plus one sub-line plus three stacked pill labels at the far right

shots.intent: 把老花洒出水不均、镀层锈蚀、水温反复的日常摩擦放大，逼出换装动机。
shots.textZone: none, the two visual states carry the contrast

shots.intent: 用四宫格证明分体阀体一键一路的出水结构，消除用法疑虑。
shots.textZone: one vermilion label bar centred under each of the four grid cells

shots.intent: 仰视微距呈现顶喷出水面与硅胶孔位密度，证明雨淋体感。
真实浴室安装场景让买家代入，同时用比例锚点交代体量。
后侧微距证明主体为厚壁金属重铸件而非薄壳镀层，撑材质信任。
并列展示手持花洒多种出水形态，让买家按偏好选择档位。
shots.textZone: one numbered circle above each unit and one short label beneath each

shots.intent: 俯视全家福交代随箱部件与配置完整度，降低下单风险。
以深色收口屏统一视觉记忆并引导下单动作。
shots.textZone: upper area headline plus one sub-line, lower-left rounded CTA button

style.backgroundSystem: board-formed concrete and grey microcement shower walls alternating with clean off-white infographic panels and one deep charcoal closing panel; real bathroom space with honed stone floor in scene shots
style.direction: premium matte-black and champagne-gold bathroom hardware commerce
style.iconSystem: thin 2px line icons in white on solid vermilion #D63A21 circles, numbered vermilion circles, hairline vermilion rules, square image frames with thin vermilion borders
style.lightingSystem: 5500K studio light with a front-left key and a hard raking side light that reads the matte black coating, brushed brass grain and every silicone outlet hole; single controlled specular streak on metal, soft directional shadow plus true contact shadow, no blown highlights
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium bathroom-hardware ecommerce visual system across the entire set; fixed palette of off-white panel #F6F5F3, cement-grey wall #A8A29A and matte charcoal black #1B1B1B with one vermilion infographic accent #D63A21, champagne gold #C9A063 reserved for the product metal only; cool-neutral tone with warm metal highlights; one modern geometric sans-serif for all Chinese and Latin copy; background system of board-formed concrete, grey microcement and honed stone in a real bathroom plus clean infographic panels; lighting system of 5500K front-left key with a hard raking side light that reads the matte coating, brushed brass grain and every silicone outlet hole, single controlled specular streak, soft directional shadow and true contact shadow; layout system of thin vermilion rules, vermilion pill labels, numbered vermilion circles and 2px line icons on vermilion discs; product presented at a stable installed vertical posture with consistent scale and physically plausible reflections; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no product redesign.
noDrift: no chrome mirror finish replacing the matte black and champagne gold two-tone
no product redesign, added or relocated parts
no brand wording, QR codes or membership badges
style.presentationRules: the set keeps one stable installed vertical posture and consistent scale across shots; champagne-gold metal #C9A063 is the product-matched accent and never recoloured; two-tone matte black plus gold boundary always visible; hoses drawn once with natural fall, no duplicated heads or arms
style.surfaceSystem: matte concrete #A8A29A wall, honed marble-look floor #E8E4DE, light stone flat-lay surface #EFEDE9, dark stone #8E8880 for macro fields
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for Chinese and Latin copy; heavy display headline in #1B1B1B (or #F6F5F3 on dark), thin grey sub-line, small labels in white on vermilion pill bars; short callouts only, never dense body text
